text:
Mira: quick follow-up from today's leadership Q&A. we need a concise public plan for API adaptive-batching, console per-route cost visibility, and Optimize suggestions UI. leadership asked for clear owners, gates, and embargo windows.
Ana: owners recap: adaptive-batching -> Jamal/eng-runtime, per-route costs -> Lin/billing+console, Optimize UI -> Priya/optimize.
Mira: legal/compliance flagged: any change that increases retention or exports needs a privacy review. Priya, retention opt-ins?
Priya: Optimize canary requires opt-in retention (30 days) for eval logs and a clear consent flow in org settings. legal OK if we add explicit opt-in copy and audit log.
Jamal: technical note: adaptive-batching touches decoder scheduling and KV-cache heuristics. we'll ship a feature-flag and SDK toggle: `enable_adaptive_batching`. fallback path will preserve previous behavior.
Trevor: infra needs embargo-safe windows. propose internal canary 2024-09-02 (48h), extended beta 2024-09-30, public roll 2024-10-14. console per-route internal preview 2024-10-01, public 2024-10-21. Optimize UI canary 2024-09-08, review two weeks after.
Ella: DevEx will prepare SDK examples and a "what changed" note when Jamal publishes the sample configs.
Kevin: marketing: we need mock screenshots and a release blurb. embargo length? leadership asked for at least 7 days between internal preview and public comms.
Mira: yes, 7-day embargo is the ask. align internal preview dates accordingly.
Lin: per-route cost will be an "Estimated" view (derived from token attribution). we'll surface a CSV export of raw tagged usage for reconciliation and a tooltip explaining differences.
Priya: UX gating for suggestions: beta pill, feedback widget, opt-in in org settings, and a short survey link post-interaction. no auto-apply during canary.
Jamal: SDK example we'll publish: `client.configure({enable_adaptive_batching:true,batching:{max_latency_ms:20,min_batch:3}})`. note: ordering of concurrent requests may differ in rare edge cases. we'll document in migration notes.
docs-bot: docs request: please attach a sample route.json and token_profile.csv to DOCS ticket so docs can render screenshots and runnable examples.
Trevor: infra gating: run pre-canary load sweep on 2024-08-28 for 6h and post results to eng-sre. Dedicated tenants with pinned models get a migration toggle in console, default OFF. we will not auto-migrate pinned orgs.
Mira: action items summary: (1) Jamal publish sample route + node script by 2024-08-25, (2) Priya implement opt-in retention flow + feedback widget by 2024-08-26, (3) Lin draft tooltip copy and CSV export flow by 2024-09-10, (4) Kevin/Ella produce embargoed screenshots by 2024-09-04, (5) Trevor post load-test results and create migration JIRA by 2024-08-29.
Kevin: will coordinate marketing copy and timing with Growth; will need screenshots and a short feature matrix row.
Jamal: technical checkpoint: canary must meet these telemetry gates: p95 regression <= 7% on sampled flows, error-rate spike <1.25x baseline, KV cache-miss increase <2%.
Priya: Optimize gating: qualitative feedback >= 20 responses in canary cohort and no systemic degradation in suggestion relevance metrics.
Lin: billing gating: backend tags must be stable for 72h before internal preview and finance wants an anonymized sample comparison (estimate vs billed) during internal preview.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary/deploy/adaptive-batching 2024-09-02 02:00 UTC. health checks: p95 latency, error-rate, KV-eviction-rate. auto-rollback on error-rate >1.5x baseline.
Mira: thanks all. i'll draft the post-all-hands summary and circulate for sign-off. owners, please update this thread when deliverables are done. :thumbsup:
